source: Recovered original EXOLON.TAP 64K memory; see games/exolon/research/manifest.json
notes: Three source monophonic score streams, parsed with original global one-note-read-per-driver-step arbitration. Command-read onsets map to the archived AY interrupt schedule: four2-step50Hz frames, then one1-stepframe. First interrupt is time0. No sub-frame CPU instruction offset or original AY pitch/volume modulation is modelled; frequency is the original base tone period. Global0xFF mutes all voices, truncating final A/B notes. Nearest MIDI pitches retain melody for orchestral scoring.
